name: disk-cleanup
description: Safe housekeeping: vacuum the journal to 14 days, clear dnf cache, autoremove orphaned packages, drop unused flatpak runtimes, delete 30-day-old cached thumbnails. Nothing user-created is touched.
author: builtin

steps.desc: Shrink the system journal to 14 days.
Remove all dnf caches and metadata.
Remove unused flatpak runtimes (not an error if flatpak is missing).
Delete cached thumbnails not viewed in 30+ days (they regenerate on demand).
